calculation.description: Fade the three-day average intraday return, normalized by trailing 20-day intraday-return volatility. Values are computed using data available at the close of the signal date and predict next-day cross-sectional returns.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive across 2020-2022 (+0.04423), 2023-2024 (+0.04156), and 2025-2027 (+0.04920). Predictive power decays at 5 days (+0.01204) and is approximately zero at 10 days (-0.00025), so this is a short-horizon factor.
